overview.title: Sigrun's Battle Rhythm
overview.subtitle: A Zerg-inspired orchestration deck inside the Hyperfractal Octree.
overview.summary: A partially working system: public knowledge and candidate verification are real; unified unattended worker continuation remains unproved. This table separates definitions, selected plays, observed instances and retired attempts.
overview.active_worker_count_status: UNKNOWN — this is an evidence snapshot, not a live fleet census.
overview.hand_note: Selected for orientation, preparation and review. Being in hand does not mean a carrier is ready to launch. Each card states its play mode.
overview.card_face_note: Original editorial game faces over inherited IDs. Costs are prerequisites; stats describe shape or cited evidence, not invented combat power or measured model fitness.
overview.coverage: 137 source catalog IDs + one existing public equipment proposal. Upstream reports 53 full definitions linted; this public import does not claim all full contracts were recovered.
overview.proof_gap: Controlled FULL_RECORD / CARD / NO_CARD trials and independent acceptance remain pending.

battle_rhythm.title: Dancing the Nataraja with Sigrun
battle_rhythm.interpretation: In Tao's metaphor, creation, constraint and renewal form a dance. Sigrun sings the coordination rhythm; disposable carriers perform bounded steps. This page expresses that intended operational self-model.

beats.engineering: Select an improvement and bind the next step.

battle_rhythm.claim_ceiling: Semantic agreement with this story is not a behavioral test. The proof is whether a fresh carrier follows the constraints and produces useful, independently accepted work with less operator intervention.

inheritance.semantic_rule: Keep stable card IDs across generation changes. Definitions, behavior, runtime status, receipts and authority stay distinct.
inheritance.cutover: Gen143 remains the integration candidate. A new generation is not required to express the current card semantics.
inheritance.public_scope: Sanitized descriptive projection; no secrets, private correspondence, wallet material or runtime authorizations.
